new_claims: For false q_N(b)=sum b_i-(N+1), finite differences over R+1 free bits produce actual source codewords.
Each such codeword has nonzero public anchor and rank in {R+1,R+2}.
For fixed free coordinate set there are at least 2^(N-R-1) distinct efficiently constructible such codewords.
The scalar key-shift statistic has exact pairwise TV q^(-r rho), hence at least q^(-r(R+2)).
The explicit family contributes at least 2^(N-R-1) q^(-2r(R+2)) to the key-sensitive squared spectral mass.
Run-81 common-eigenvalue decapsulation is explicitly false-instance vulnerable whenever t > r(R+2).
